definitions.gloss: menopause; climacteric period; change of life
definitions.explanation: the period of life (typically mid-40s to mid-50s) when menstruation ceases and hormone levels change, often accompanied by various physical and emotional symptoms

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{更年期|こうねんき}の{症状|しょうじょう}に{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: My mother is troubled by menopausal symptoms.

examples.japanese: {更年期|こうねんき}には{体調管理|たいちょうかんり}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Managing your health is important during menopause.

examples.japanese: {男性|だんせい}にも{更年期|こうねんき}{障害|しょうがい}はある。

notes:
COMPOUND:
{更年|こうねん} (turning point of age) + {期|き} (period)

COMMON SYMPTOMS ({更年期|こうねんき}{症状|しょうじょう}):
- ホットフラッシュ - hot flashes
- {発汗|はっかん} - sweating
- {不眠|ふみん} - insomnia
- {気分|きぶん}の{変動|へんどう} - mood swings
- {疲労感|ひろうかん} - fatigue

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {更年期|こうねんき}{障害|しょうがい} - menopausal disorder
- {更年期|こうねんき}{症状|しょうじょう} - menopausal symptoms
- {男性|だんせい}{更年期|こうねんき} - male menopause (andropause)

NOTE:
While traditionally associated with women, {男性|だんせい}{更年期|こうねんき} (male menopause/andropause) has become a recognized condition in Japan.
